newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian shipper to raise $99 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Croatian shipper to raise $99 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Croatian leading shipper Croatia Line said on Tuesday it would soon raise a $99 million (600 billion kuna) syndicated loan arranged Germany's Hamburgische Landesbank, Croatian television reported.

"Approval by the European banks for...loan under very favourable conditions and without any state guarantees confirms the high business rating that Croatia Line and its management enjoy on the capital market," managing director Dario Vukic said, without specifying the rate.
He said the loan would be used to restructure all of the company's long-term and reduce some short-term debts, which now total two billion kuna.
It will also enable the company to renew its fleet and boost its position among the world's competitors.
